nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): performs c = a + b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then computes c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b guarded by a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner sets newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then transfers ownership.
ECASH constructor: sets token metadata and mints the entire supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns the balances mapping entry.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits 'to'.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls external receiveApproval before returning.
Payable fallback function: unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner forwards an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary token address.
Addition a + b inside safeAdd, relying solely on a require-based overflow guard.
Subtraction a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication a * b inside safeMul, guarded by a division round-trip check.
Division a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied token contract.
Unconditional revert() inside the payable fallback, consuming gas for any sent ETH.
